The '''XNA-580''' was an experimental device that was secretly developed by [[Raahan Ma'ase]]. It had the ability to scramble the brainwaves of most [[Species/Legends|species]], rendering them useless. Anyone exposed to this for a long time would [[Death/Legends|die]].
